title: Du‘a for knowledge
intro: A short du‘a from the Qur’an to ask Allah for more knowledge.

learn.html: Allah knows everything, and He gives knowledge to whoever He wills. We ask Him to increase our knowledge with this du‘a:

learn.label: Rabbi zidni ‘ilma
learn.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge!

learn.text: And say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

learn.alt: A row of children with school bags, seen from behind
learn.caption: Rabbi zidnee ‘ilmaa!

learn.title: ✏️ Task
learn.html: Write this du‘a on the cover of your notebook! Say it before you start learning and before your homework. Give this du‘a as a gift to your friends!

practice.title: Build the du‘a
practice.prompt: Tap the words in the right order.

options: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
My Lord is enough for me
